cues.text: So much I wanna tell you, but you need to go away
cues.translation: 네게 하고 싶은 말이 너무 많지만 넌 떠나야 해

cues.text: I love you with my whole heart,
but it aches, it fucking aches
Step back and give me space,
or God knows what the fuck I'll say
cues.translation: 안 그러면 내가 무슨 지랄을 할지 몰라

cues.text: This shit gets old so fast,
but I go through it every day

I don't know
Wh-why does it hurt to love you?
cues.translation: 왜 왜 너를 사랑하면 아픈 거야

cues.text: I mean it, go away
Keep falling into circles,
I'll cut off my fucking head
cues.translation: 내 빌어먹을 머리를 잘라 버릴 거야

cues.text: I can't remember anything of what I must've said
cues.translation: 내가 대체 무슨 말을 했는지 하나도 기억나지 않아

cues.text: If pain is beauty,
what the fuck does this shit mean instead?
cues.translation: 대체 이 빌어먹을 건 무슨 뜻이야

cues.text: I feel two thousand feelings,
and a thousand are regret
If this shit is so wrong,
then why the fuck can I not stop?
Why am I wired to keep making everything my fault?
cues.translation: 왜 모든 걸 내 탓으로 만들도록 배선된 거야

cues.text: I try to be a good girl, but that isn't in the cards
cues.translation: 착한 여자애가 되려 하지만 내 패에는 그런 운이 없어

cues.text: I'll self-destruct, blow up our life,
leave everything in shards
I'm living in delusions and that's not a way to live
cues.translation: 난 망상 속에 사는데 그건 살아갈 방식이 아니야

cues.text: Keep asking me for more,
when I have nothing left to give
If I keep going now, then I'm just bound to fall apart
cues.translation: 지금 계속 가면 난 결국 무너질 수밖에 없어

cues.text: Just useless dreams and tears,
and forever broken hearts
The pressure gets to me too much,
I always fucking care
If you were in my shoes,
then you'd pull out your fucking hair
Whenever I see you, I have so much I wanna share
cues.translation: 너를 볼 때마다 나누고 싶은 게 너무 많아

cues.text: But I'll sit here all bottled up, completely unaware
cues.translation: 하지만 난 여기서 전부 꾹 담아 둔 채 아무것도 모른 척 앉아 있어
